questions.question: Why do people need water? Give three reasons.
questions.expected_answer: About two thirds of our bodies is water, and we lose water all day, so we must drink to replace it. Water carries food and oxygen in our blood, helps us digest food, keeps us cool when we sweat and helps us think. Without water, a person can live for only a few days.

questions.question: Name five daily uses of water in your personal life.
questions.expected_answer: Drinking, cooking, washing ourselves (bathing, showering, washing hands and brushing teeth), washing clothes and dishes, cleaning the house, flushing the toilet, and watering the garden and giving water to animals.

questions.question: Describe three ways a family can save water at home.
questions.expected_answer: Take short showers instead of baths; turn off the tap while brushing teeth; reuse grey water to flush the toilet or water the garden; fix leaking taps and pipes; run the washing machine only when full; catch rain water in a tank.
